Farm Tour & Feed the Animals - 1hr - Rp150,000 per person

Join our fast and friendly 1 hour Farm Tour.

We are just 5km north of Ubud on the right hand side as you are driving to Tegallalang Rice Paddies !

Meet our Furry Friends - get to know Susu & Taksu our family cows, Happy & Lily the Farm cats, Adam & Eve our ducks and our assorted family of chickens, turtles and fish
Rice Paddy & Jungle walk - guided walk through our local rice paddies & jungle - lots of Insta opportunities !



Tour includes ;

Refreshing Welcome: Organic Fruit Juice
Meet our animals and help us feed them !
Rice Paddy & Jungle walk
Learn about Balinese culture and legends
Discover the differences between chemical and organic farming




Available for groups of 2 - 10 people. Please book 1 day ahead if possible !

We are a locally run family organic farm using Permaculture techniques hidden in the jungle just 5km north of Ubud Bali !
